description: A stout reinforcing paper glued across the back of a textblock before covering to strengthen the spine. A tough brown or other heavy sheet is laid over the back and headbands; on weighty volumes linen or thin leather is used in its place. This is a structural spine reinforcement, not the general text-leaf stock.
name: spine lining paper

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XII, p.152. Internet Archive.
